About Carroll County
Carroll County was formed in 1833 from parts of several surrounding counties. We are named after Charles Carroll of Carrollton, the last living signer of the Declaration of Independence.
Our county covers 400 square miles of beautiful Ohio countryside with 14 townships. Carrollton serves as our county seat, where the historic courthouse stands as a symbol of our community's dedication to public service.
